narrative_purpose: Shows the signalling channel that survives total darkness: every pattern on these bodies is being generated, not reflected, and the same display coordinates the pack while disorienting the prey.
subject: Four of the squid-ray animals in completely black water, arranged in a loose converging formation. Across the upper surface of each animal's mantle and out along its wings run broad transverse bands of glowing light - alternating cyan and magenta stripes - drawn as a travelling wave, with the bands tightly bunched near the head and stretched wider toward the tail so the pattern reads as moving. The nearest animal is largest and most detailed; two mid-distance animals carry the same band pattern slightly offset in phase; the farthest is a dim silhouette showing only its glowing bands. Between them, a small school of pale fish is scattering in disarray. No other light source exists in the frame.
scene: Deep aphotic open ocean, no surface, no floor, absolute darkness except the animals' own emitted light.
camera: Wide slightly elevated three-quarter view looking down across the converging formation.
light: The animals' glowing bands are the only illumination; they cast weak coloured light onto the nearest water and faintly onto each other; everything beyond that light is black.
palette: Void indigo to pure black water, Pandora cyan and biolum magenta in the glowing bands, faint mist grey on the scattering fish, no warm tones anywhere.
style: Painterly naturalist night plate, restrained and eerie rather than neon or graphic.
detail_level: High detail on the nearest animal's band pattern and head; the distant animals reduced to glow and silhouette.
composition: Nearest animal across the lower left, two mid-distance animals upper centre and right, farthest animal a faint glow at the upper left, large regions of pure black water at the right and lower edges for annotations.
consistency_notes: Same animal design as fig-00-cover in all four individuals: four eyes, twelve tentacles, ray-like wings. Light must clearly be emitted from within the skin, never a reflection or a spotlight from outside the frame.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no arrows, no sunlight, no visible water surface, no neon UI glow, no lens flare, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon style
